key.name: icon-size
key.description: Size of the app icons on the desktop, in pixels.

key.name: replace-app-grid
key.summary: Replace GNOME's app grid with the desktop
key.description: The Show Apps button (GNOME dash or Dash to Panel) and Super+A reveal the desktop launcher by minimizing all windows with GNOME's animation, instead of opening the overview app grid. Pressing again restores the windows. Swiping or scrolling to the app grid page in the overview is disabled.

key.name: app-order
key.summary: Order of the All Apps grid
key.description: Desktop file ids and "folder:ID" entries in display order, written when tiles are dragged. Items not listed are appended in default order.

key.name: all-monitors
key.summary: Show the launcher on every monitor
key.description: When off, only the primary monitor gets a launcher.

key.name: margin
key.description: Space between the launcher grid and the edge of the work area, in pixels.

key.name: max-width
key.description: Limits how wide the grid can grow, in pixels; the grid is centred. 0 means no limit.
